# Aigent design system

> A design system you can reshape, written so you and your coding agent work from the same rules. It picks a visual direction, then checks the result in a real browser. MIT. Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and other Agent Skills clients.

The project's own product, brand, and design docs outrank anything in this repository. Aigent's own brand is not the target project's truth.

## Install

- Skills CLI: `npx skills add wrg32786/aigent-design-system --yes`
- Claude Code, every project: clone this repo to `~/.claude/skills/aigent`
- Claude Code, one project: `npx --yes --allow-git=all github:wrg32786/aigent-design-system install`
- Cursor: point a rule at `SKILL.md`, or drop the clone into `.cursor/skills/aigent`
- Codex: clone to `~/.agents/skills/aigent` (or the project) and point `AGENTS.md` at `SKILL.md`
- OpenCode: copy skill folders into `.opencode/skills/`
- New site: `npx --yes --allow-git=all github:wrg32786/aigent-design-system create-site my-site`

Browser-backed commands (Taste, Resolve, Vision) need Node and Chromium (`setup-browser`).

## Start here

- [README](https://github.com/wrg32786/aigent-design-system/blob/master/README.md): what it does, install, workflow, tokens
- [Root skill](https://github.com/wrg32786/aigent-design-system/blob/master/SKILL.md): entry point when the repo is installed as one skill
- [aigent-design](https://github.com/wrg32786/aigent-design-system/blob/master/skills/aigent-design/SKILL.md): authority order, operating model, Variance / Motion / Density, completion bar
- [skills/README.md](https://github.com/wrg32786/aigent-design-system/blob/master/skills/README.md): specialist skills (inspiration, quality, creative production)
- [tokens/system.css](https://github.com/wrg32786/aigent-design-system/blob/master/tokens/system.css): neutral tokens and primitives you can change
- [PRODUCT.md](https://github.com/wrg32786/aigent-design-system/blob/master/PRODUCT.md) and [DESIGN.md](https://github.com/wrg32786/aigent-design-system/blob/master/DESIGN.md): what the system is for

## Workflow

```
SHAPE → DIRECT → BUILD → TASTE → RESOLVE → SEE → POLISH
```

Lock a direction before a large page is built. First render is not final. Render, inspect, fix, render again. Never claim Taste, Resolve, or Vision ran when they did not.

## Commands

```bash
npx --yes --allow-git=all github:wrg32786/aigent-design-system taste .
npx --yes --allow-git=all github:wrg32786/aigent-design-system resolve --init --target .
npx --yes --allow-git=all github:wrg32786/aigent-design-system resolve --target . --url http://127.0.0.1:3000
npx --yes --allow-git=all github:wrg32786/aigent-design-system vision prepare --target . --url http://127.0.0.1:3000
```

## Live demo

The Site Library at https://tools.theaigent.co/aigent-site-vault is the showcase. Every business and person shown there is fictional.
